## 答案

### 1) 强化学习框架采用的算法：GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization，组相对策略优化）

在 `演示-R1论文-20261112/deepseek_r1 (part 1 of 5).md` 的 §2.1（约 L27）和 §2（约 L25）中，论文逐字写道：

> “GRPO (Shao et al., 2024) is the reinforcement learning algorithm that we adopt to train DeepSeek-R1-Zero and DeepSeek-R1. It was originally proposed to simplify the training process and reduce the resource consumption of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) (Schulman et al., 2017), which is widely used in the RL stage of LLMs (Ouyang et al., 2022).”

> “To facilitate large-scale RL efficiency, we adopt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) (Shao et al., 2024).”

论文的引言部分还说明了基础模型的选择和奖励信号的来源（part 1，摘要后的引言）：

> “we build upon DeepSeek-V3-Base (DeepSeek-AI, 2024b) and employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) (Shao et al., 2024) as our RL framework. The reward signal is solely based on the correctness of final predictions against ground-truth answers, without imposing constraints on the reasoning process itself.”

**GRPO 的关键机制**（part 1 · §2.1，Eq. 1–3）：对每个问题采样一组输出，用**组内归一化的优势（advantage）**替代 critic（价值模型）：

> A_i = (r_i − mean({r_1,…,r_G})) / std({r_1,…,r_G})   （Eq. 3）

附录 A.3 中 Figure 3 的图注也清楚地说明了这一点（part 1 · A.3）：

> “GRPO foregoes the value model, instead estimating the advantages from group scores.”

训练超参数（part 1 · §2.1）：learning rate 3e-6、KL 系数 0.001、采样温度 1、每题采样 16 个输出、最大长度 32,768 → 65,536 tokens、共 10,400 步（1.6 epochs）、每步 32 题（batch 512）、每 400 步把参考模型更新为最新策略模型。

### 2) 不使用神经网络奖励模型的原因：论文明确回避了神经网络奖励模型

part 1 · §2.2 Reward Design 原文明确写道：

> “Notably, we abstain from applying neural reward models—whether outcome-based or process-based—to reasoning tasks. This decision is predicated on our observation that neural reward models are susceptible to reward hacking during large-scale reinforcement learning. Moreover, retraining such models necessitates substantial computational resources and introduces additional complexity into the training pipeline, thereby complicating the overall optimization process.”

因此，论文有两条理由：
1. **奖励被钻空子（reward hacking）**：在大规模强化学习过程中，神经网络奖励模型容易被策略模型钻空子，而策略模型会找到高奖励信号但并未真正对齐目标的捷径；
2. **训练成本与流程复杂度**：奖励模型需要重新训练，会消耗大量算力，并且让整条训练管线更加复杂。

作为替代方案，论文采用的是**规则化奖励（rule-based reward）**：

> “we employ rule-based rewards to deliver precise feedback for data in mathematical, coding, and logical reasoning domains. Our rule-based reward system mainly consists of two types of rewards: accuracy rewards and format rewards.”

并且 `Reward_rule = Reward_acc + Reward_format`（Eq. 4，其中 accuracy 和 format 权重相同）。其中，accuracy reward 用于检查最终答案是否正确（数学题要求按指定格式作答，以便进行规则校验；代码题则交给编译器运行预定义测试用例），format reward 要求把推理过程包裹在 `<think>` 和 `</think>` 中。

part 4 · §G.2 对过程奖励模型（PRM）的失败尝试另有一处佐证：

> “Third, once a model-based PRM is introduced, it inevitably leads to reward hacking (Gao et al., 2022), and retraining the reward model needs additional training resources and it complicates the whole training pipeline.”

part 4 · §G.1 “The importance of verifiers” 也给出了同方向的结论（这是论文总结的成功经验）：

> “two approaches—rule-based reward models (RMs) and LLMs to assess an answer's correctness against a predefined ground-truth—serve as robust mechanisms for mitigating issues related to reward hacking.”

### 一个必要的边界说明

论文回避神经网络奖励模型的范围是**推理任务**。对于通用（非推理）数据，DeepSeek-R1 的次级 RL 阶段**确实用了模型化奖励**（part 1 · §3.1 Model-based Rewards）：

> “For general data, we resort to reward models to capture human preferences in complex and nuanced scenarios.”

具体为 helpfulness 奖励模型（66,000 对偏好数据，在 DeepSeek-R1 上增加 reward head 预测标量偏好分）和 safety 奖励模型（106,000 条安全标注数据）。因此更准确的说法是：推理相关的 RL 使用规则化奖励；通用对齐相关的 RL 仍使用偏好奖励模型。

## Result

**问题**：DeepSeek-R1 的强化学习框架是什么算法？为什么不用神经网络奖励模型？

**答案**：RL 框架 = **GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）**，训练其后代模型 DeepSeek-R1-Zero 与 DeepSeek-R1；GRPO 用组内归一化优势（Eq.3）替代 value/critic 模型，以简化流程、降低 PP0 的资源消耗。推理任务**不用**（outcome-based 或 process-based）神经网络奖励模型，原因有二：① 大规模 RL 下神经网络奖励模型易被 reward hacking；② 重训奖励模型耗费大量算力并使训练管线复杂化；因此改用**规则化奖励 = accuracy reward + format reward**（权重相同）。边界：通用（非推理）对齐数据仍使用偏好奖励模型（helpful RM 66k 对 + safety RM 106k 条）。
